column1: NESFIC-D-36: TRUSTED GOVERNMENT AI DATASET MASTER
Challenge: NESFIC 2026 (Challenge Stream 1) | Innovation: Trust-Gated, Version-Aware, Provenance-First Government RAG
Prepared on: 2026-10-14 | Authority: Antigravity Government AI Pair Programmer & Domain Engineering Team

This master workbook constitutes the gold-standard, auditable, and machine-readable government knowledge corpus engineered for Project NESFIC-D-36. The central architectural principle of this dataset is that Large Language Models (including Google Gemini) are language-generation, reasoning, and drafting engines—NOT authoritative repositories of government truth. All official knowledge must strictly originate from authenticated statutory evidence that has satisfied an immutable Trust Gate comprising SHA-256 integrity checks, Official Gazette publication verification, institutional authority validation, temporal applicability tracking, and claim-level provenance.

column1:
The RAG engine evaluates every document and answer through a 5-tier Trust Gate:
1. File Integrity Tier: Validates immutable SHA-256 hash against original collection manifest.
2. Gazette & Cryptographic Tier: Inspects digital signatures (PKCS#7) where available, or authenticates Official Gazette seals/imprints.
3. Institutional Authority Tier: Verifies that the issuing officer (Governor, Secretary, Director) possesses statutory jurisdiction.
4. Temporal & Version Tier: Assesses whether the provision is ACTIVE, AMENDED, or SUPERSEDED as of the query date.
5. Evidence Sufficiency Gate: If evidence is complete, generates VERIFIED answer. If conflicting or unverified, routes to VERIFICATION_REQUIRED or CANNOT_GENERATE.
